market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Fed rate hike and 5% yields create headwind for equities. Earnings season (Costco, Darden Sept 24) is a key catalyst; Goldman's sour-earnings warning suggests downside risk. Gold/silver bid continues. Crypto stable above $80K. Watch for midterms-driven political volatility and gas price pressure on consumer sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure supercycle ($31.6T by 2050) and semiconductor innovation (Micron, Huawei) drive structural growth. Buffett succession provides governance clarity for Berkshire. Labor market resilient (196K claims). However, 7%+ mortgage rates and persistent inflation cap consumer recovery. Energy transition and data center grid constraints create both risk and opportunity.
